final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN (
    'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari',
    'Collegi, luoghi di ricovero, case di pena, caserme, conventi',
    'Attività scolastiche',
    'Ospedali, cliniche, case di cura e assimilabili'
  )
  AND surface_area >= 1600
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND healthcare >= 75
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area, which maps directly to surface_area. The 30-person capacity is not converted to an area threshold because no verified gross-area-per-occupant value was supplied.

Energy class D or better, as explicitly requested by the user. The Turin, minimum gross floor area (1600 sqm), capacity (30 people) and proximity to healthcare requirements are not energy-related columns and are excluded from this energy filter.

User prefers a property near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics) for the senior care facility. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.
